list.name: machine_id
list.query: SELECT device_id AS __text FROM public.devices WHERE enabled = true ORDER BY device_id ASC;
list.label: Machine

list.name: interface
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT iface_name FROM public.net_metrics WHERE device_id IN (${machine_id:singlequote}) ORDER BY iface_name
list.label: Interface

options.content:

panels.description: OS Taskbar navigation and CSS theme.

panels.title: ◈ CPU Load

targets.rawSql: SELECT cpu_load_percent AS value FROM public.sys_metrics WHERE time > NOW() - INTERVAL '2 minutes' AND device_id IN (${machine_id:singlequote}) ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.description: Current CPU utilization (%) for the selected machine. Yellow >80%, Red >90%.

panels.title: ◈ RAM Usage

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND((ram_used_mb / NULLIF(ram_total_mb, 0) * 100)::NUMERIC, 1) AS value FROM public.sys_metrics WHERE time > NOW() - INTERVAL '2 minutes' AND device_id IN (${machine_id:singlequote}) ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.description: Current RAM utilization (%) for the selected machine. Yellow >85%, Red >95%.

panels.title: ◈ Storage Saturation

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND((disk_used_gb / NULLIF(disk_total_gb, 0) * 100)::NUMERIC, 1) AS value FROM public.sys_metrics WHERE time > NOW() - INTERVAL '2 minutes' AND device_id IN (${machine_id:singlequote}) ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.description: Current disk utilization (%) for the selected machine. Yellow >70%, Red >90%.

panels.title: ◈ Temperature

targets.rawSql: SELECT temp_c AS value FROM public.sys_metrics WHERE time > NOW() - INTERVAL '2 minutes' AND device_id IN (${machine_id:singlequote}) AND temp_c > 0 ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.description: Current temperature (°C) for the selected machine. Yellow >70°C, Red >85°C.

panels.title: ◈ Memory Saturation

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  bucket AS time,
  device_id AS metric,
  ROUND(AVG(avg_ram_used / NULLIF(avg_ram_total, 0) * 100)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "RAM %"
FROM public.sys_hourly
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND device_id IN (${machine_id:singlequote})
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1 ASC

panels.description: RAM utilization for the selected machine. Yellow at 75%, Red at 90%. Gapfilled via LOCF.

panels.title: ◈ Network Bandwidth (Per-Interface)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_bucket('10 seconds', time) AS time,
  device_id || ' - ' || iface_name AS metric,
  ROUND(AVG(rx_mbps)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "Download (Mbps)",
  ROUND(AVG(tx_mbps)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "Upload (Mbps)"
FROM public.net_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND device_id IN (${machine_id:singlequote})
  AND iface_name IN (${interface:singlequote})
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1 ASC

SELECT
  time_bucket('10 seconds', time) AS time,
  device_id || ' - ' || iface_name AS metric,
  ROUND(AVG(rx_mbps)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "Download (Mbps)",
  ROUND(AVG(tx_mbps)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "Upload (Mbps)"
FROM public.net_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND device_id IN (${machine_id:singlequote})
  AND iface_name IN (${interface:singlequote})
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1 ASC

panels.description: Per-interface bandwidth queried from per-interface rows in the net_metrics hypertable. Download positive, Upload mirrored (negative-Y axis, #EF4444).

panels.title: ◈ Temperature Sensors

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  bucket AS time,
  device_id AS metric,
  ROUND(AVG(max_temp)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "Temperature (°C)"
FROM public.sys_hourly
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND device_id IN (${machine_id:singlequote}) AND max_temp > 0
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1 ASC

SELECT
  bucket AS time,
  device_id AS metric,
  ROUND(AVG(max_temp)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "Temperature (°C)"
FROM public.sys_hourly
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND device_id IN (${machine_id:singlequote}) AND max_temp > 0
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1 ASC

panels.description: Temperature readings from sensor OIDs (UCD-SNMP lmSensors) for the selected machine.

panels.title: ◈ LDI Throughput & Process Efficiency

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_bucket('10 seconds', time) AS time,
  device_id AS metric,
  ROUND(AVG(throughput)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "Throughput"
FROM public.ldi_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND device_id IN (${machine_id:singlequote}) AND throughput > 0
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1 ASC

SELECT
  time_bucket('10 seconds', time) AS time,
  device_id AS metric,
  ROUND(AVG(pe_1)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "PE"
FROM public.ldi_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND device_id IN (${machine_id:singlequote}) AND pe_1 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1 ASC

panels.description: LDI manufacturing throughput (left axis, #10B981) and Process Efficiency in µm (right axis, #F59E0B). PE within ±10µm tolerance is normal.

panels.title: ◈ LDI Junction Efficiency & Humidity

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_bucket('10 seconds', time) AS time,
  device_id AS metric,
  ROUND(AVG(je_1)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "JE"
FROM public.ldi_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND device_id IN (${machine_id:singlequote}) AND je_1 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1 ASC

SELECT
  time_bucket('10 seconds', time) AS time,
  device_id AS metric,
  ROUND(AVG(humidity)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "Humidity"
FROM public.ldi_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND device_id IN (${machine_id:singlequote}) AND humidity > 0
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1 ASC

panels.description: Junction Efficiency in µm (purple) and Humidity % (blue, right axis). High humidity may affect LDI precision.

panels.title: ◈ LDI Quality Scatter

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_bucket('10 seconds', time) AS time,
  device_id AS metric,
  ROUND(AVG(pe_1)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "PE"
FROM public.ldi_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND device_id IN (${machine_id:singlequote}) AND pe_1 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1 ASC

SELECT
  time_bucket('10 seconds', time) AS time,
  device_id AS metric,
  ROUND(AVG(je_1)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "JE"
FROM public.ldi_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND device_id IN (${machine_id:singlequote}) AND je_1 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1 ASC

panels.description: LDI quality scatter with ±10µm tolerance zone (#10B981 band). Points outside the zone indicate quality risk.

panels.title: ◉ Estimated Daily Power Cost (THB)

targets.rawSql:
WITH hourly_power AS (
  SELECT
    device_id,
    AVG(power_watt) AS avg_watts
  FROM public.ldi_metrics
  WHERE time > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    AND power_watt > 0
  GROUP BY device_id
)
SELECT
  device_id AS metric,
  ROUND((avg_watts * 24 / 1000 * 4)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "Daily Cost (THB)"
FROM hourly_power
ORDER BY "Daily Cost (THB)" DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.description: Estimated 24-hour electricity cost in Thai Baht. Calculated as: avg_watts x 24h / 1000 x 4 THB/kWh tariff. Based on rolling 1-hour average power consumption from LDI manufacturing metrics. Thresholds: green < 500 THB, yellow 500-1000 THB, red > 1000 THB.

panels.title: ◉ Power Efficiency Ratio

targets.rawSql:
WITH efficiency AS (
  SELECT
    device_id,
    AVG(throughput) AS avg_throughput,
    AVG(power_watt) AS avg_power
  FROM public.ldi_metrics
  WHERE time > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    AND power_watt > 0
  GROUP BY device_id
)
SELECT
  device_id AS metric,
  CASE
    WHEN avg_power > 0 THEN ROUND((avg_throughput / avg_power)::NUMERIC, 4)
    ELSE 0
  END AS "Efficiency (THB/W)"
FROM efficiency
WHERE avg_power > 0
ORDER BY "Efficiency (THB/W)" DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.description: Manufacturing throughput per watt of power consumed. Higher is better. Calculated as: throughput_count / power_watt. Tracks how efficiently the LDI machine converts electrical energy into productive output. Below 1.0 indicates excessive idle power draw relative to production volume.

panels.title: ◉ Yield Risk Index

targets.rawSql:
WITH baseline AS (
  SELECT
    device_id,
    AVG(throughput) AS avg_throughput,
    STDDEV(throughput) AS sigma_throughput
  FROM public.ldi_metrics
  WHERE time > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
  GROUP BY device_id
),
current AS (
  SELECT
    device_id,
    AVG(throughput) AS current_throughput,
    AVG(power_watt) AS current_power
  FROM public.ldi_metrics
  WHERE time > NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes'
  GROUP BY device_id
)
SELECT
  c.device_id AS metric,
  CASE
    WHEN b.sigma_throughput = 0 OR b.sigma_throughput IS NULL THEN 0
    WHEN c.current_power > b.avg_throughput * 0.8 AND c.current_throughput < b.avg_throughput - (2 * b.sigma_throughput) THEN 3
    WHEN c.current_throughput < b.avg_throughput - b.sigma_throughput THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS "Risk Level"
FROM current c
JOIN baseline b ON b.device_id = c.device_id
ORDER BY "Risk Level" DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.description: Composite risk score (0-100) indicating probability of yield loss. Triggered when throughput drops below baseline minus 2 standard deviations while power consumption remains above 80% of baseline — indicating the machine is drawing full power but producing substandard output. Score 0 = normal, 100 = critical yield loss suspected.

panels.title: ◈ CPU Anomaly Score (Z-Score)

targets.rawSql: WITH stats AS (SELECT avg(avg_cpu) as mu, stddev(avg_cpu) as sigma FROM public.sys_hourly WHERE device_id IN (${machine_id:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(bucket)) SELECT bucket AS time, (avg_cpu - mu) / NULLIF(sigma, 0) AS "Z-Score" FROM public.sys_hourly, stats WHERE device_id IN (${machine_id:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(bucket) ORDER BY time ASC

panels.description: CPU Z-Score per machine. Cyan = normal, Amber >= 2 sigma, Red >= 3 sigma.

panels.title: ◈ Temperature Anomaly Score (Z-Score)

targets.rawSql: WITH stats AS (SELECT avg(max_temp) as mu, stddev(max_temp) as sigma FROM public.sys_hourly WHERE device_id IN (${machine_id:singlequote}) AND max_temp > 0 AND $__timeFilter(bucket)) SELECT bucket AS time, (max_temp - mu) / NULLIF(sigma, 0) AS "Z-Score" FROM public.sys_hourly, stats WHERE device_id IN (${machine_id:singlequote}) AND max_temp > 0 AND $__timeFilter(bucket) ORDER BY time ASC

panels.description: Temperature Z-Score per machine. Cyan = normal, Amber >= 2 sigma, Red >= 3 sigma.

panels.title: ◈ CPU / RAM / Storage Distribution

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'CPU Load %' AS metric, AVG(cpu_load_percent) AS value FROM public.sys_metrics WHERE time > NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes'
SELECT 'RAM Used %' AS metric, AVG(ram_used_mb / NULLIF(ram_total_mb, 0) * 100) AS value FROM public.sys_metrics WHERE time > NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes'
SELECT 'Disk Used %' AS metric, AVG(disk_used_gb / NULLIF(disk_total_gb, 0) * 100) AS value FROM public.sys_metrics WHERE time > NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes'

panels.description: CPU/RAM/Storage usage distribution across selected machines

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'Healthy' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM public.sys_metrics WHERE time > NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes' AND cpu_load_percent < 80 AND ram_used_mb / NULLIF(ram_total_mb, 0) * 100 < 85

SELECT 'Warning' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM public.sys_metrics WHERE time > NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes' AND (cpu_load_percent BETWEEN 80 AND 90 OR ram_used_mb / NULLIF(ram_total_mb, 0) * 100 BETWEEN 85 AND 95)
SELECT 'Critical' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM public.sys_metrics WHERE time > NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes' AND (cpu_load_percent > 90 OR ram_used_mb / NULLIF(ram_total_mb, 0) * 100 > 95)
